assignments.reason: The ability to taste sweetness in prayer (יכול לטעם מתיקות בתפלה) is essentially a holy, positive state — the experiential dimension of covenant-keeping purity. Its essential nature belongs to the domain of guarding the covenant (Package 2). The source text (line 2-3) establishes that tasting sweetness in prayer is the state called 'כל עצמותי תאמרנה' and that it requires תקון הברית (covenant-repair). The sweetness itself is identified as מיין מתיקין (sweet waters, Package 2 core node). The node's essential nature — the holy experience of prayer imbued with the purity of the covenant — places it squarely in the positive covenant-keeping domain alongside מיין מתיקין, מיין דדכין, זרע קדש, תקון הברית, עצם, and אריה.
